embeds.title: BLHA LEAGUE VOTING
embeds.description: Formal franchise votes are recorded here.

fields.name: ONE FRANCHISE = ONE VOTE
fields.value: Each franchise casts one vote, whether it has one owner or several. Co-owners may discuss proposals but do not create an additional vote.

fields.name: THE RULES OF A VOTE
fields.value: Material Amendments need **8 of 12** affirmative votes. Votes happen only in the offseason, last 7 days, and follow a proposal posted at least 7 days earlier. Non-votes are not affirmative votes (Article XX).

fields.name: A VALID VOTE POST STATES
fields.value: The proposal • Voting options • Opening time • Closing time • Threshold required • Final result

fields.name: DISCUSSION
fields.value: Debate proposals in **gm-lounge**. This channel is for the proposal and the recorded vote.
